measurement: Same production converter, native continuous decoder, VAD, main-queue callbacks, caption history, latency tracker and transcript writer. Owned synthesized audio repeated at real-time pace without resets. Estimated token timings; no microphone or real classroom. Recent percentile uses last 10000 samples; max and timeout counts cover whole session.
memoryNote: Physical footprint includes compressed/swapped pages. Active checkpoints grew from 1422.831 MB at one minute to 1464.690 MB at two hours (about 2.94%). After decoder finalization the process footprint was 59.329 MB. Resident memory alone is not total memory use. This is a two-hour trend, not a proof of zero leaks or an eight-hour validation.

priorFailedAttempt.note: Execution paused while the Mac was locked. Exact pause cause was not established; raw delay was retained, not clipped.

referenceAccuracy.method: Complete cycles only, grouped using native estimated word-start timestamps and the known exact WAV period. Final partial cycle excluded from accuracy only; all words remain in the archive. Boundary/word-end timestamps are estimates, not independent acoustic ground truth.
